title: The Lift Bridge
synopsis: The mill on the hill goes dark, and the Hush comes over the pines. Rook crosses the old lift bridge and pulls the lever. But old chains don't hold forever.
note: The last train runs again tomorrow.
lines: River line tonight. Hold the bar.
The mill on the hill... it went dark.
There. On the hill, behind us.
The old lift bridge. I have an idea.
Deep water. It won't cross that.
...Our lights. It's eating them from there.
Go! Lights stay on if we move!
It will cross. But we keep moving.
Next stop, the mill town. Lights ahead!
